## What landed

PR #24373 (`b2e78701f7`) landed #11979: under `single`, the platform-admin grant is owned by the Default Organization. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` inserts the promoted grant with `organization_id: defaultOrganizationId`, and `resolve-authz-context.ts#grantAnchorsPlatformStanding` anchors either the organization-less row or the Default Organization's grant when no wall is enforced. PR #24463 (#24438) re-pointed the item's dangling `source` anchor at that predicate and changed nothing else.

## What the item says (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`, item `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor`, revision 3)

- Clause 6 (`acceptance[5]`) names #11979 as its own re-author trigger: "if that lands, this clause is re-authored, not read as a regression". It has landed.
- Four phrases still describe the fresh `single` boot before #24373: `personas[0]` ("grant-anchored via the unscoped admin_full_access row that first-registrant promotion writes"), `fixtures.knownGaps[0]` ("also holds the unscoped admin_full_access grant under single"), `acceptance[0]` ("the ADR-0068 D2 unscoped-grant anchor stays the only door"), and `acceptance[5]` ("clauses 1 and 3 observe it live").
- Every verdict still holds (the dev's reading): M is refused, the admin gets 200, the walled row confers nothing, the config anchor confers. Only the attribution of the admin's live 200 is now wrong.

## Premises, each with a re-check

- `git show origin/main:docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json | grep -c 'grant-anchored via the unscoped admin_full_access row'` → 1 expected before the fix. Control: `grep -c 'platform-owner-email-anchor'` → at least 1.
- `git grep -c 'organization_id: defaultOrganizationId' origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` → at least 1 (the dev's reading; re-measure).

## Target

- Re-author those four phrases so a fresh `single` boot's live door is the Default Organization's `admin_full_access` grant (ADR-0131 D5); keep the organization-less row's "single only, nothing under a wall" assertion (now test-pinned only).
- Add the `[ADR-0131 D5] under single the Default Organization's admin_full_access grant is the anchor` describe (`resolve-authz-context.platform-admin-config.test.ts`) to clause 6's verify and to `automated.ref`.
- Bump the item's revision 3 → 4 with one history entry, which also names PR #24463's anchor re-point.
- ⛔ No verdict is changed to say less than the product does. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. `skip-changeset` (docs only).
